instruction: A candid medium shot of friends playing frisbee in an outdoor park with green grass and trees in the background. On the left, the large Black man (R1) in a black t-shirt and black pants leans forward, holding a blue frisbee. On the right, the woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans stands facing him, reaching out playfully. In the background, the East Asian man (R3) in a red polo shirt, the woman with an afro (R6) in a red t-shirt, and the woman in a black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt stand cheering and watching the game. Bright, natural daylight casts soft shadows on the grass.

R4 reaches out playfully toward R1 rather than holding the frisbee herself
